posts.content_md:
M. Boulte gave a talk on PVA at SPIE two years ago. She's from Laval University, Quebec ( [http://www.imaging.org/store/epub.cfm?abstrid=310](http://www.imaging.org/store/epub.cfm?abstrid=310) ) where most of the work on PVA seems to be done. I specifically asked her about index modulation and I was told that this was not an important parameter for them They were apparently more interested in decreasing the moisture sensitivity of DCG-type materials. 

I've got plenty of papers on PVA. As you know, I have students tomorrow and a sick laser so I'm going to be busy. I'll dig at the papers on Monday.
